summary: Focused final verification completed for zoom/transform/export/save-cart and legacy invalid-draft fixture tightening. Backend targeted regression passed; frontend high-risk checks passed with browser-emulated CDP pinch and Konva live-transform restore verification on rectangle and temporary circle product.
action_items: Optional hardening: seed at least one active circle-area product by default to avoid admin setup during QA touch/transform regression runs.
Optional: add a dedicated automated browser-emulated pinch regression test in CI to stabilize multi-touch coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy invalid-draft regression is now correctly testing bounds revalidation path instead of accidentally passing via snapshot-version mismatch guard.
Export pipeline correctly restores camera/view after both 100% and 250%+pan exports while preserving identical decoded RGBA output hashes.
CanvasElement live-transform telemetry (data-live-element) is emitted during onTransform, and lastValid restore applies to actual Konva node geometry before mouseup/mouseup-end commit path.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary admin products for circle-area transform checks: ids 6edc2134-b9bb-4fff-ae46-7ef06617a9de and 49f75955-3ff9-4384-a0ab-dfd9f02e6bb3; both archived (cleaned) after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-touch verification was BROWSER-EMULATED (CDP dispatch on mobile viewport, no physical hardware). Confirmed pinch zoom changed 100%->400% within 50-400 bounds and did not mutate data-elements in stabilized run. Rectangle and temporary circle checks at 250%+pan verified pre-mouseup corner changes, live telemetry, and invalid-restore-to-lastValid on actual Konva node geometry. Save->cart rapid queue passed (single cart item, navigation success).
rca of the issue: RCA addressed in tests: prior legacy-invalid fixture used hardcoded snapshot.version=2, allowing 409 via product-version guard rather than true geometry revalidation. Updated fixture now reads current product snapshot from API and asserts correction-focused message content, ensuring the intended bounds/content revalidation path is exercised.
